notes.title: Dabado Puzzles Major Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello adventure lovers!
We are happy to announce our second Dabado Puzzles major update!


Update 1.2 add lot of new content and improve some major gameplay mechanics making the game more flexible and adoptable for players with different game mastery level.
Here is the list with most of them:

[list]
- Variety gameplay improvements.
- Two additional quests.
- Three new items in the Maria's store which give unique features and make the game more balanced.
- Visual and UX improvements.
- Window mode.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40413284/f1d20c12929172c1958f1a9137cfecb2b9b30e87.jpg[/img]

These improvements will bestow you with even more pleasant game experience. 
Any support, feedback and positive reviews are very welcome!

notes.title: Dabado Puzzles Major Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi there!
We are happy to announce our first Dabado Puzzles update!


Dabado Puzzles Update 1.1 contains lot of new features and make the game, more deep, diverse and interesting. Here is the list with most of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40413284/f44894f546286ccb2c6653a7eabe93c50ea74604.jpg[/img]
[i]Symmetry feature[/i]

[list]
- One major gameplay feature, called Symmetry. It gives to the player many new benefits while arranging the blocks in the construction. If used properly, this feature accelerate significantly Light collecting to progress the LVLs.
- Three additional quests.
- Two new NPCs with their personal story.
- One new Unique Level where the player have total freedom of using blocks and can create beautiful constructions just for fun. It's some kind of art playground.
- Lots of new visual and UX improvements, many background animations.
- Hidden treasures.
- Five new Steam achievements. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40413284/9526b38740ae624ea1db075e371e61f6723d0a1b.png[/img]
[i]Balloon quest[/i]

We hope that all this improvements will give you even more joy and satisfaction while playing Dabado Puzzles. 
In near future we plan other updates so stay tuned.
We will be grateful to all of you who help us spreading this beautiful hand-drawn game in the world.
Thank you :)

notes.title: Dabado Puzzles demo is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

Our colorful and challenging exploration puzzler now have a Demo version, which can be accessed indefinitely.

Dabado Puzzles - Demo contains several levels, and includes all functionality/mechanics of the base game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40413284/ce2c6231ae4afa53a4ffb5b42f18577dd970ce72.jpg[/img]

If you are interested to know more about game, you can read this review: https://ladiesgamers.com/dabado-puzzles-review/

By the way, the game is not so hard, you just need to experiment and try different approaches - this is the guarantee to success ;)

Have fun playing and hope to hear your positive words and feedback about this game!
